feature: A way in without a collection, the whole line (handoff design_handoff_the99_no_collection_entry, R2 + R3; plan 2026-10-15-no-collection-entry.md, the route x viewport inventory)
note: Needs COLLECTION_EDIT_ENABLED=true, NO_COLLECTION_ENTRY_ENABLED=true and PRECONS_ENABLED=true for the reader. Each row's `account` names the state it needs: A zero cards and no decks, B the writes that build a collection from A, C a collection built in the app with no upload, D an account holding cards. The sheet runs every row at the phone width and then every row at desktop, so one run photographs one state's rows: run it once per state, on a fresh account each time. Rows marked WRITES add a deck or cards (s12, s10, s5, s19), and `clearAbout` marks the About gate seen and restores it afterwards: run any sheet that includes them on a scratch branch made from local-dev ONLY, never on local-dev, staging or production. Rows that write nothing may also run read-only against staging, except s14, whose Preview stores an unconfirmed upload. Steps press only controls inside <main>: the nav's locked-slot note is opened from the shell and is pinned by the nav tests. S4 (pending), S6, S7 and S11 (refusals) and the switch-off states (S15, S16) cannot be forced from a browser and are proved by component tests. The ways group's shared-component check lives in no-collection-entry-shared.json, because `check:shared` holds every row of an inventory with a `shares` block to that block.
